source.policy: Stable release tag only; preserve prior reviewed source and translation corrections. Development-branch changes are excluded.
source.old_french_pin_removed: f643529cb91973f071ee09eae958b0cb0d7c44b1 / 2.59.1; all 29 French bodies and protected code match current source
source.upstream_delta: News, release entry, root news list, eight coverage cells and guide execution cache. Guide, command, configuration and FAQ XML prose did not change between the stable tags.

review_scopes.prior_full_review_plus_delta: Prior complete Japanese, German and Russian bilingual reviews, rechecked against preserved output bodies; later wording changes and all six-language source corrections inspected, plus new full technical and rendered checks.
review_scopes.full_technical_and_targeted_semantic: All 29 bodies checked for aligned prose-unit coverage, code, metadata, headings, numerical facts and protected literals; semantic review concentrated on PITR, backup dependencies/retention, exclusions, encryption, SFTP, delta behavior, transferred data, FAQs and anomalies. This is not a new independent line-by-line review of every historical release sentence.
review_scopes.stable_release_delta: Full bilingual review of all added security/release paragraphs in five translations, exact security script from pinned XML, both guide caches matched before updating, review of metrics and metadata. All prior PITR, terminology, option-name and historical-warning corrections retained.

findings.issue: PITR fallback-to-latest claim contradicted the 2.59.2 implementation and v2.37 release history
findings.resolution: Corrected FAQ, restore command and both guides in all six editions. A missing matching time/LSN backup is an error. Time requires backup stop < target; LSN requires backup stop <= target.

findings.issue: French source pin/attribution remained 2.59.1 while actual content and examples used 2.59.2
findings.resolution: Removed obsolete pin; aligned cascade, registry, six attribution pages and README.

findings.issue: French delta restore/backup confused with incremental, upload with download, soft delete with progressive deletion; diagnostic message translated
findings.resolution: Source-aware corrections preserve delta/incremental distinction, upload direction, reversible deletion, exact diagnostic and command meanings.

findings.issue: Chinese omitted some host-option conditions and reference names
findings.resolution: Restored repo-host/pg-host conditions, compression/database-selection/SFTP option names and complete retention examples.

findings.issue: Historical v1.20 warning truncated in English and four translations
findings.resolution: Completed the statement that PostgreSQL >= 9.0 is not affected, using the pinned upstream XML. Chinese was already complete. Corrected French implication that upgrading beyond major version v1 was necessary.

findings.issue: Earlier language-specific acceptance fingerprints were stale and not enforced by their gates
findings.resolution: This shared gate requires all 145 final source/translation fingerprints, independent technical checks and complete production outputs.

findings.issue: Untranslated French captions, awkward command titles, malformed German conditional sentence and Russian trailing whitespace
findings.resolution: Corrected display prose while retaining all source anchors and executable blocks.

findings.issue: Stable 2.59.3 security advisory and release notes were absent from all six mirrored editions
findings.resolution: Added the complete pinned advisory, exact check script, OpenSSL 1.0 detection limitation, stanza/repository remediation, both bug fixes and localized current-release links.

findings.issue: Guide output, restore selectors and coverage data still used the 2.59.2 snapshot
findings.resolution: Synchronized 12 guides using both stable execution caches, including fractional PITR targets, plus the eight changed coverage cells. All other reviewed technical examples and prose corrections are preserved.

findings.issue: OINK 1.2.0 English Lunr pipeline discarded Cyrillic queries, hiding Russian security and recovery topics
findings.resolution: Included the existing minimal Cyrillic substring-search override after verifying its exact delta from the published module. Added six-language security-query and Latin/CJK non-regression tests, then verified actual desktop/mobile interactions.

protected_content.chinese_anchors: Existing localized Chinese anchors retained; real links are checked, including cross-page fragments.
protected_content.technical_variants: Only two reviewed Chinese wording variants; neither changes a command, value or example.
protected_content.stable_release_delta: Only the new upstream security-check script and verified stable-tag guide examples change protected blocks; other command/configuration examples retain the reviewed baseline.

reviewed_variants.reason: English space denotes the space character, translated as 空格; it is not a literal database name.
Combined English command shorthand is expanded to the exact three names stanza-create, stanza-update and stanza-delete.

example_sync.method: scripts/sync-pgbackrest-examples.py; full command identity and output matching against both stable-tag caches; commands were not executed. Distribution HTML output placeholders were not imported.
